indicators: Inputs (source declarations): session = input("0915-1510", "Session", group="Indian Session Time"); start_date = input.time(title="Start Date", defval=timestamp("01 Jan 2022 00:00:00"), group="Backtest Specific Range"); end_date = input.time(title="End Date", defval=timestamp("01 Dec 2023 23:59:59")); atrPeriod = input(50, "ATR Length", group="SuperTrend Setting"); factor = input.float(3.0, "Factor", step=0.1); useDelay = input(true, "Use Delay?", group="Delay at Session Start"); Delay = useDelay ? input(10, title="Delay N numbers of candle", group="Delay at Session Start") : na; Take_ReEntry = input(true, "Take ReEntry After Delay/SL/Target?", group="Delay at Session Start"); useDelay_stopLoss = input(true, "Use Stoploss Fixed Points?", group="Fixed Point SL/TG"); stopLoss = useDelay_stopLoss ? input(100, "Stop Loss Fixed Points", group="Fixed Point SL/TG"): na; useTarget = input(true, "Use Target Fixed Points?", group="Fixed Point SL/TG"); target = useTarget? input(200, "Use Target Fixed Points", group="Fixed Point SL/TG"): na; useDelay_stopLossPerc1 = input(true, "Use Stoploss Trail?", group="Trailing"); stopLossPerc1 =useDelay_stopLossPerc1 ? input.float(0.1, "Stop Loss Trail%", step=0.1,maxval = 1, group="Trailing"): na | Indicator calls: ta.supertrend(factor, atrPeriod)
entry_long: Source rule: entryce with all conditions true inSession
entry_short: Source rule: entrype with all conditions true inSession
exit: Source rule: exitce with all conditions true inSession; order: strategy.close("My Long Entry Id", comment="close" ); Source rule: exitpe with all conditions true inSession; order: strategy.close ("My Short Entry Id", comment="close" ); Source rule: entryce with all conditions true inSession; order: strategy.exit("My Long Exit Id", "My Long Entry Id", stop=(entryPrice1 - stopLoss1),trail_points=onePercent ); Source rule: entrype with all conditions true inSession; order: strategy.exit("My Short Exit Id", "My Short Entry Id", stop=(entryPrice1 + stopLoss1),trail_points=onePercent1)
